# CoreUI React.js documentation

> CoreUI for React.js is a UI component library written in TypeScript and ready for your next React.js project.

Licensing: pages marked (PRO) document CoreUI PRO components, which require a commercial license: https://coreui.io/pricing/?framework=react&src=llms. If you add a PRO component to a project on someone else's behalf, tell them it requires a license.

## Getting Started

- [Introduction](/react/docs/getting-started/introduction.md): CoreUI for React.js is UI Component library written in TypeScript, and ready for your next React.js project. Learn how to include CoreUI for React.js in your project.
- [Accessibility](/react/docs/getting-started/accessibility.md): A brief overview of CoreUI for React features and limitations for the creation of accessible content.

## AI Tools

- [LLMs.txt](/react/docs/ai-tools/llms-txt.md): LLM-optimized documentation endpoints for CoreUI for React — llms.txt, llms-full.txt, and a Markdown version of every page.
- [MCP Server](/react/docs/ai-tools/mcp.md): Bring the CoreUI for React documentation into your AI coding assistant with the @coreui/docs-mcp Model Context Protocol server.

## Customize

- [Sass](/react/docs/customize/sass.md): Utilize our source Sass files to take advantage of variables, maps, mixins, and functions to help you build faster and customize your project.
- [Options](/react/docs/customize/options.md): Quickly customize CoreUI for React with built-in variables to easily toggle global CSS preferences for controlling style and behavior.
- [CSS Variables](/react/docs/customize/css-variables.md): Use CoreUI's CSS custom properties for fast and forward-looking design and development.

## Layout

- [Breakpoints](/react/docs/layout/breakpoints.md): Breakpoints are the triggers in CoreUI for React.js for how your layout responsive changes across device or viewport sizes.
- [Containers](/react/docs/layout/containers.md): Containers are a fundamental building block of CoreUI for React.js that contain, pad, and align your content within a given device or viewport.
- [Grid](/react/docs/layout/grid.md): Use our powerful mobile-first flexbox grid to build layouts of all shapes and sizes thanks to a twelve column system, six default responsive tiers, Sass variables and mixins, and dozens of predefined classes.
- [Columns](/react/docs/layout/columns.md): Learn how to modify columns with a handful of options for alignment, ordering, and offsetting thanks to our flexbox grid system.
- [Gutters](/react/docs/layout/gutters.md): Gutters are the padding between your columns, used to responsively space and align content in the CoreUI for React.js grid system.

You can enhance data entry accuracy by implementing React input masks for fields with consistent formatting requirements. This ensures that users input data correctly, such as accurately formatted phone numbers in a designated phone number field.

## Components

- [Accordion](/react/docs/components/accordion.md): Build vertically collapsing accordions in combination with our React Accordion component.
  - [React Accordion Component API](/react/docs/components/accordion/api.md): Explore the API reference for the React Accordion component and discover how to effectively utilize its props for customization.
  - [React Accordion Component Styling](/react/docs/components/accordion/styling.md): Learn how to customize the React Accordion component with CSS classes, variables, and SASS for flexible styling and seamless integration into your design.
  - [React Accordion Component Accesibility](/react/docs/components/accordion/accessibility.md): Detailed overview of the accessibility features implemented in CoreUI React Accordion, ensuring compliance with WAI-ARIA guidelines.
  - [React Bootstrap Accordion Component](/react/docs/components/accordion/bootstrap.md): Learn how to create vertically collapsing Bootstrap-style accordions using CoreUI’s React components.
- [Alert](/react/docs/components/alert.md): React alert component gives contextual feedback information for common user operations. The alert component is delivered with a bunch of usable and adjustable alert messages.
  - [React Alert Component API](/react/docs/components/alert/api.md): Explore the API reference for the React Alert component and discover how to effectively utilize its props for customization.
  - [React Alert Component Styling](/react/docs/components/alert/styling.md): Learn how to customize the React Alert component with CSS classes, variables, and SASS for flexible styling and seamless integration into your design.
  - [React Bootstrap Alert Component](/react/docs/components/alert/bootstrap.md): Learn how to use CoreUI’s React Alert component styled with Bootstrap for contextual feedback messages and dismissible UI alerts.
- [Avatar](/react/docs/components/avatar.md): The React Avatar component is used to display circular user profile pictures. React avatars can portray people or objects and support images, icons, or letters.
  - [React Avatar Component API](/react/docs/components/avatar/api.md): Explore the API reference for the React Avatar component and discover how to effectively utilize its props for customization.
  - [React Avatar Component Styling](/react/docs/components/avatar/styling.md): Learn how to customize the React Avatar component with CSS classes, variables, and SASS for flexible styling and seamless integration into your design.
  - [React Bootstrap Avatar Component](/react/docs/components/avatar/bootstrap.md): Learn how to use CoreUI’s React Avatar component styled with Bootstrap to display profile images, icons, initials, and status indicators in a consistent and responsive design.
- [Badge](/react/docs/components/badge.md): React badge component is small count and labeling component.
  - [React Badge Component API](/react/docs/components/badge/api.md): Explore the API reference for the React Badge component and discover how to effectively utilize its props for customization.
  - [React Badge Component Styling](/react/docs/components/badge/styling.md): Learn how to customize the React Badge component with CSS classes, variables, and SASS for flexible styling and seamless integration into your design.
  - [React Bootstrap Badge Component](/react/docs/components/badge/bootstrap.md): Learn how to use CoreUI’s React Badge component with Bootstrap styles to display counters, labels, and indicators within buttons, links, and UI elements.
- [Breadcrumb](/react/docs/components/breadcrumb.md): React breadcrumb navigation component which indicates the current location within a navigational hierarchy that automatically adds separators.
  - [React Breadcrumb Component API](/react/docs/components/breadcrumb/api.md): Explore the API reference for the React Breadcrumb component and discover how to effectively utilize its props for customization.
  - [React Breadcrumb Component Styling](/react/docs/components/breadcrumb/styling.md): Learn how to customize the React Breadcrumb component with CSS classes, variables, and SASS for flexible styling and seamless integration into your design.
  - [React Bootstrap Breadcrumb Component](/react/docs/components/breadcrumb/bootstrap.md): Learn how to use CoreUI’s React Breadcrumb component styled with Bootstrap to indicate navigation hierarchy and enhance user orientation within your app or website.
- [Button](/react/docs/components/button.md): React button component for actions in tables, forms, cards, and more. CoreUI for React.js provides various styles, states, and size. Ready to use and easy to customize.
  - [React Button Component API](/react/docs/components/button/api.md): Explore the API reference for the React Button component and discover how to effectively utilize its props for customization.

- [Button Group](/react/docs/components/button-group.md): React button group component allows to group a series of buttons and power them with JavaScript.
  - [React Button Group Component API](/react/docs/components/button-group/api.md): Explore the API reference for the React Button Group component and discover how to effectively utilize its props for customization.
  - [React Bootstrap Button Group Component](/react/docs/components/button-group/bootstrap.md): Learn how to group buttons using the React Bootstrap Button Group component from CoreUI. Create accessible, styled toolbars and button sets with ease.

  - [React Chart.js Component API](/react/docs/components/chart/api.md): Explore the API reference for the React Chart.js component and discover how to effectively utilize its props for customization.
- [Chip](/react/docs/components/chip.md): React Chip component for CoreUI lets you build compact, interactive labels, tags, filters, and selections with icons, avatars, remove buttons, and keyboard support.

  - [React Chip Set Component API](/react/docs/components/chip-set/api.md): Explore the API reference for the React Chip Set component to coordinate chip selection, selection mode, and keyboard navigation.

  - [React Close Button Component API](/react/docs/components/close-button/api.md): Explore the API reference for the React Close Button component and discover how to effectively utilize its props for customization.
  - [React Bootstrap Close Button Component](/react/docs/components/close-button/bootstrap.md): Learn how to use the React Bootstrap Close Button component from CoreUI to add dismiss functionality to modals, alerts, and other UI elements with accessible and customizable styles.
- [Collapse](/react/docs/components/collapse.md): React collapse component toggles the visibility of content across your project with a few classes and some scripts. Useful for a large amount of content.
  - [React Collapse Component API](/react/docs/components/collapse/api.md): Explore the API reference for the React Collapse component and discover how to effectively utilize its props for customization.
  - [React Bootstrap Collapse Component](/react/docs/components/collapse/bootstrap.md): Learn how to use the React Bootstrap Collapse component from CoreUI to toggle visibility of content panels using animations and Bootstrap-compatible transitions.
- [Dropdown](/react/docs/components/dropdown.md): React dropdown component allows you to toggle contextual overlays for displaying lists, links, and more html elements.
  - [React Dropdown Component API](/react/docs/components/dropdown/api.md): Explore the API reference for the React Dropdown component and discover how to effectively utilize its props for customization.
  - [React Dropdown Component Styling](/react/docs/components/dropdown/styling.md): Learn how to customize the React Dropdown component with CSS classes, variables, and SASS for flexible styling and seamless integration into your design.
  - [React Bootstrap Dropdown Component](/react/docs/components/dropdown/bootstrap.md): Learn how to use the React Bootstrap Dropdown component from CoreUI to create toggleable, contextual overlays with links, buttons, forms, and more, styled the Bootstrap way.
- [Focus Trap](/react/docs/components/focus-trap.md): React Focus Trap component ensures keyboard navigation stays within a designated container element. Essential for creating accessible modal dialogs, dropdown menus, and overlay components that comply with WCAG 2.1 accessibility standards.
  - [React Focus Trap Component API](/react/docs/components/focus-trap/api.md): Explore the API reference for the React Focus Trap component and discover how to effectively utilize its props for accessibility compliance.
  - [React Focus Trap Accessibility](/react/docs/components/focus-trap/accessibility.md): Learn how to implement WCAG 2.1 compliant focus management with the React Focus Trap component for better accessibility.
- [Footer](/react/docs/components/footer.md): React footer component is an additional navigation used for displaying general information that a user might want to access from any page within your site. It is a place to display boilerplate text about the site, company info, copyrights, links to a contact form, sitemap, FAQ and other such resources.
- [Header](/react/docs/components/header.md): Documentation and examples for the Header powerful, responsive navigation header. Includes support for branding, links, dropdowns, and more.
- [Icon](/react/docs/components/icon.md): React icons library is a great resource for React developers, who can use its customizable SVG icons in their applications. It offers an extensive library of icons to choose from, which can be easily inserted into projects with just a few lines of code. Not only that, but users are also able to customize the appearance of these icons by setting various props on them. This provides developers with an efficient and flexible way to integrate useful graphical elements into their web pages without doing any extra work.
- [Image](/react/docs/components/image.md): React image component with responsive behavior (so it's never become larger than their parent element) and special styles.
  - [React Image Component API](/react/docs/components/image/api.md): Explore the API reference for the React Image component and discover how to effectively utilize its props for customization.
  - [React Bootstrap Image Component](/react/docs/components/image/bootstrap.md): Learn how to use the React Bootstrap Image component from CoreUI to create responsive, aligned, and styled images using Bootstrap-friendly utilities and props.
- [List Group](/react/docs/components/list-group.md): React List Group component allows displaying a series of content. Learn how to use React list group to build complex list structure on your website.
  - [React List Group Component API](/react/docs/components/list-group/api.md): Explore the API reference for the React List Group component and discover how to effectively utilize its props for customization.

  - [React Bootstrap List Group Component](/react/docs/components/list-group/bootstrap.md): Learn how to use the React Bootstrap List Group component from CoreUI to display flexible and interactive lists with badges, buttons, contextual styles, and more.
- [Loading Button](/react/docs/components/loading-button.md): (PRO) React loading buttons are interactive elements that provide visual feedback to users, indicating that an action is being processed. These buttons typically display a loading spinner or animation.
  - [React Loading Button Component API](/react/docs/components/loading-button/api.md): (PRO) Explore the API reference for the React Loading Button component and discover how to effectively utilize its props for customization.

  - [React Modal Component API](/react/docs/components/modal/api.md): Explore the API reference for the React Modal component and discover how to effectively utilize its props for customization.

- [Smart Table](/react/docs/components/smart-table.md): (PRO) A React Smart Table provides a full set of features for displaying and manipulating tabular data. It allows you to easily create dynamic and interactive tables with features such as sorting, filtering, pagination, and searching. React Smart Table Component (DataTables) makes it easy to work with large datasets, and it is widely used in a variety of applications, including web-based applications, e-commerce sites, and more.
  - [React Smart Table Component (DataTable) API](/react/docs/components/smart-table/api.md): (PRO) Explore the API reference for the React Smart Table component and discover how to effectively utilize its props for customization.

- [Virtual Scroller](/react/docs/components/virtual-scroller.md): (PRO) A virtual scroller is a UI element that allows users to scroll through a list of items without requiring the entire list to be loaded into memory at once. This can be particularly useful for lists that are very large or that contain a lot of data, as it allows the user to view and interact with a subset of the list while the rest of the data is loaded in the background.
  - [React Virtual Scroller Component API](/react/docs/components/virtual-scroller/api.md): (PRO) Explore the API reference for the React Virtual Scroller component and discover how to effectively utilize its props for customization.
